title: Death Generator Structures
description: A vanilla-friendly data pack that adds custom structures generated upon player death, turning tragic moments into exciting discoveries!
body:
**Death Generator Structures** is a unique Minecraft data pack that transforms player deaths into opportunities for adventure and loot.
Every time a player dies, this pack triggers the generation of a custom structure at or near the death location. These structures can include hidden tombs, eerie graveyards, abandoned ruins, treasure vaults, or mysterious altars – fully customizable depending on the variants you include in the pack.
Key Features:

- **Death-Triggered Generation**: Structures spawn automatically on death, making every demise feel meaningful and rewarding.
- **Vanilla Compatible**: No mods required – pure data pack using Minecraft's built-in structure system.
- Customizable: Easily add or modify your own .nbt structure files for endless variety (dungeons, traps, loot rooms, etc.).
- **Multiplayer Friendly**: Works seamlessly on servers; each player's death generates a unique structure.
- **Balanced for Survival**: Encourages risky playstyles while providing potential rewards for returning to your death spot.

- **Perfect for survival worlds**, challenge maps, or servers wanting to add a twist to the standard death experience. Turn "You Died" into "Treasure Awaits"!
Compatible with Minecraft 1.21+ (adjust pack_format as needed). Simply drop into your world's datapacks folder and /reload!
